import sys

oo = 1000000000

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not input_data:
        return
    n = int(input_data[0])
    m = int(input_data[1])
    if n > m:
        n, m = m, n
    size = 1 << n
    curr = [[oo] * size for _ in range(size)]
    for j in range(size):
        curr[0][j] = 0
    col = 0
    while col < m:
        next_mat = [[oo] * size for _ in range(size)]
        limit = 1 if col == m - 1 else size
        for c0 in range(size):
            curr_row = curr[c0]
            for c1 in range(size):
                cur_val = curr_row[c1]
                if cur_val != oo:
                    for c2 in range(limit):
                        done = 0
                        for i in range(n):
                            if ((1 << i) & c1) == 0:
                                up = i - 1
                                down = i + 1
                                if up >= 0 and ((1 << up) & c1) != 0:
                                    done |= 1 << i
                                if down < n and ((1 << down) & c1) != 0:
                                    done |= 1 << i
                                if ((1 << i) & c0) != 0:
                                    done |= 1 << i
                                if ((1 << i) & c2) != 0:
                                    done |= 1 << i
                        new_val = cur_val + n - bin(done).count('1')
                        if new_val < next_mat[c1][c2]:
                            next_mat[c1][c2] = new_val
        curr = next_mat
        col += 1
    res = oo
    for i in range(size):
        for j in range(size):
            if curr[i][j] < res:
                res = curr[i][j]
    print(n * m - res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
